title: Kenworth T610 SAR FUPS high tensile polished Aluminium Road Train Bullbar. #16
description: Kenworth T610 SAR FUPS high tensile polished aluminium Road Train Bullbar. Two main, one piece 76mm cross tubes through drilled uprights and recessed into drilled outer uprights (optional 88 or 100mm tubes on request). 100mm box uprights shown with outer uprights set flush with main channel. Two additional 12mm flat bars mounted vertically from main channel to dross bar in the centre area of the grill for maximum strength and protection. Driving light mounts to suit application. Heavy duty backing plate with 38mm tow pin, Reversible Aluminium Road Train / Long Vehicle signs with polished aluminium covers plus Dangerous Goods books on aluminium mounting plates. Combination LED indicator/daylight running lights mounted in outer uprights. Driving light mounts to customer spec. Front mudflap mounts on rear of main channel. Bull bar can be custom built to your specifications.
